def get_prime_factors(num):
    factors = set()
    d = 2
    temp = num
    # Check 2 separately
    if temp % 2 == 0:
        factors.add(2)
        while temp % 2 == 0:
            temp //= 2
    
    d = 3
    while d * d <= temp:
        if temp % d == 0:
            factors.add(d)
            while temp % d == 0:
                temp //= d
        d += 2
    if temp > 1:
        factors.add(temp)
    return factors
